facts.text: Through the Flagship Match Commitment, eligible out-of-state students pay tuition equivalent to the in-state rate at their home state's flagship university.

sources.title: Flagship Match - Undergraduate Admissions - The University of Maine
sources.quote: The Flagship Match Commitment is UMaine's merit-based scholarship program for qualified out-of-state students. Instead of paying standard out-of-state tuition rates, eligible students pay a tuition rate equivalent to in-state tuition of their home state's flagship university.
